_doc: Expert fills cards + lines, then sets approvedBy/approvedAt. text = cap with {} stripped (generated). say = TTS-only pronunciation (e.g. VaR → V-A-R); captions/srt/ASR keep text. Never let dialogue-loop rewrite these: it runs --check-only. brand: eyebrow label (default from 科目归类), endTitle/endLine of the end card (empty = default); acronyms keep their case (VaR). glossary: {"ES": "预期尾部损失"} adds the gloss in captions at first use. Two lines may share a shot (L07a/L07b on p6).
